## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. For a theorem, explain the
statement's intended use and any changed assumptions or arithmetic semantics.

## Validation

List the checks run and their results. Provider changes need relevant numerical
certification, rejection controls and frozen-source replay; documentation-only
changes can use `make docs-check`.

## Proof and source boundaries

For imported or adapted results, identify the original definition/source and
update attribution. For verification changes, describe the Lean root, supported
source profile and any new trust boundary.
